26072-scotch-loch-fishing.creator: "Black Palmer"
26072-scotch-loch-fishing.description: A book by "Black Palmer". e do not pretend to write or enlarge upon a new subject. Much has been said and written--and well said and written too--on the art of fishing; but loch-fishing _per se_ has been rather looked upon as a second-rate performance, and to dispel this idea is one of the objects for which this present treatise has been written.

arxiv-2104-11559.title: Optimizing small BERTs trained for German NER
arxiv-2104-11559.creator: Jochen Zöllner, Konrad Sperfeld, Christoph Wick, Roger Labahn
arxiv-2104-11559.description: Abstract Currently, the most widespread neural network architecture for training language models is the so called BERT which led to improvements in various NLP ( NLP ) tasks. In general, the larger the number of parameters in a BERT model, the better the results obtained in these NLP tasks.

arxiv-2107-09276.title: Yukawa-Casimir Wormholes
arxiv-2107-09276.creator: Remo Garattini
arxiv-2107-09276.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Remo Garattini. In this work, we consider a Yukawa modification of the Casimir wormhole. With the help of an Equation of State, we impose Zero Tidal Forces. We will examine two different approaches: in a first approach, we will fix the form of the shape function of the Casimir wormholes modified by a Yukawa term in three different ways and finally a superposition of different profiles.

arxiv-2204-04846.title: Storage and manipulation of single x-ray photons via nuclear hyperfine splitting
arxiv-2204-04846.creator: Guangru Bai, Zengxiu Zhao, Jianpeng Liu, Zuoye Liu, Guangyue Hu, Xiangjin Kong
arxiv-2204-04846.description: Abstract The commissioning of novel x-ray sources opens the new field of x-ray quantum optics, which expands the light-matter interactions into x-ray-nuclear regime Adams et al. 2013 . Compared to optical photons, x-rays have a number of desirable properties such as deeper penetration, better focus, and correspondingly superior spatial resolution, as well as robustness.

arxiv-2209-04230.title: Survey on Deep Fuzzy Systems in regression applications: a view on interpretability
arxiv-2209-04230.creator: Jorge S. S. Júnior, Jérôme Mendes, Francisco Souza, Cristiano Premebida
arxiv-2209-04230.description: Abstract Regression problems have been more and more embraced by deep learning (DL) techniques. The increasing number of papers recently published in this domain, including surveys and reviews, shows that deep regression has captured the attention of the community due to efficiency and good accuracy in systems with high-dimensional data.

arxiv-2303-11316.title: Generative Semantic Segmentation
arxiv-2303-11316.creator: Jiaqi Chen, Jiachen Lu, Xiatian Zhu, Li Zhang
arxiv-2303-11316.description: Abstract We present Generative Semantic Segmentation (GSS), a generative learning approach for semantic segmentation. Uniquely, we cast semantic segmentation as an image-conditioned mask generation problem . This is achieved by replacing the conventional per-pixel discriminative learning with a latent prior learning process. Specifically, we model the variational posterior distribution of latent variables given the segmentation mask.

arxiv-2310-16366.title: Green’s function and LDOS for non-relativistic electron pair
arxiv-2310-16366.creator: Tomasz M. Rusin
arxiv-2310-16366.description: Abstract The Coulomb Green’s function (GF) for non-relativistic charged particle in field of attractive Coulomb force is extended to describe the interaction of two non-relativistic electrons through repulsive Coulomb forces. Closed-form expressions for the GF, in the absence of electron spins, are derived as one-dimensional integrals.

arxiv-2311-14174.title: Rigorous Hydrodynamics from Linear Boltzmann Equations and Viscosity-Capillarity Balance
arxiv-2311-14174.creator: Florian Kogelbauer, Ilya Karlin
arxiv-2311-14174.description: Abstract Exact closure for hydrodynamic variables is rigorously derived from the linear Boltzmann kinetic equation. Our approach, based on spectral theory, structural properties of eigenvectors and the theory of slow manifolds, allows us to define a unique, optimal reduction in phase space close to equilibrium.

arxiv-2408-14395.title: Martingale deep neural network for very high-dimensional stochastic optimal controls Thanks: Date: September 23, 2026 (First version available on arXiv:2408.14395 as preprint on Aug. 26, 2024).
arxiv-2408-14395.creator: Wei Cai, Shuixin Fang, Wenzhong Zhang, Tao Zhou
arxiv-2408-14395.description: Abstract We propose a martingale deep learning method for very high-dimensional stochastic optimal control problems (SOCPs) via their associated Hamilton–Jacobi–Bellman equations and the verification theory for the optimal control. The method decomposes the problem into two coupled components: a martingale formulation for the value function and an integral optimality condition for the feedback control.

arxiv-2501-06110.title: Quantum networks using rare-earth ions
arxiv-2501-06110.creator: Wolfgang Tittel, Mikael Afzelius, Adam Kinos, Lars Rippe, Andreas Walther
arxiv-2501-06110.description: Abstract We review concepts and recent work related to creating light-matter interfaces for future quantum networks based on rare-earth ion-doped crystals. More precisely, we explore their unique suitability for creating photon sources, optical quantum memories for light, and qubits that allow quantum information processing.

arxiv-2507-21285.title: Curiosity by Design: An LLM-based Coding Assistant Asking Clarification Questions
arxiv-2507-21285.creator: Harsh Darji, Thibaud Lutellier
arxiv-2507-21285.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Harsh Darji, Thibaud Lutellier. Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used as coding assistants. However, the ambiguity of the developer’s prompt often leads to incorrect code generation, as current models struggle to infer user intent without extensive prompt engineering or external context. This work aims to build an LLM-based coding assistant that mimics the human code review process by asking clarification questions when faced with ambiguous or under-specified queries.

arxiv-2509-01898.title: DroneSR: Rethinking Few-shot Thermal Image Super-Resolution from Drone-based Perspective
arxiv-2509-01898.creator: Zhipeng Weng, Xiaopeng Liu, Ce Liu, Xingyuan Guo, Yukai Shi, Liang Lin
arxiv-2509-01898.description: Abstract Although large scale models achieve significant improvements in performance, the overfitting challenge still frequently undermines their generalization ability. In super resolution tasks on images, diffusion models as representatives of generative models typically adopt large scale architectures. However, few-shot drone-captured infrared training data frequently induces severe overfitting in large-scale architectures.
